parsed.name: 化学气相沉积系统
parsed.description: 一种带加热与工艺气体流量控制的化学气相沉积设备，用于在实验室中按配方控制温度和气氛，实现薄膜沉积与材料生长。
parsed.description_en: A chemical vapor deposition system with heating and process-gas flow control, used in laboratories to run recipes with defined temperature and gas conditions for thin-film deposition and materials growth.
